title: Monster
description: A creature/enemy. Each monster has exactly one element (Wuxing five-phase) that governs how phased effects interact with it via data/wuxing. Its attacks and innate abilities are drawn from the shared effect registry through schema.json#/definitions/appliedEffect, exactly like spells and consumables.

phase.description: The monster's element. Required — every monster has exactly one. Determines elemental affinity: incoming phased effects resolve against it through the generating/overcoming/weakening/insulting cycles in data/wuxing.

attributes.description: The eight attributes (1-10), keyed by ability id. Optional; engines derive missing values from level.

hitPoints.description: Authored baseline HP; engines may derive from END + level.

abilities.description: The monster's attacks and innate powers, drawn from the shared effect registry (data/effects). A monster typically wields effects of its own phase, but need not.
